issues.description: The DDNode dataclass field order differs between the template and the solution. In template/dd.py the DDNode is declared with 'successors' before 'v' (constructor signature: DDNode(successors, v)), whereas in the solution dd.py the declaration has 'v' before 'successors' (constructor signature: DDNode(v, successors)). This changes the generated dataclass __init__ parameter order and therefore the constructor signature. Because the problem statement explicitly instructs students not to modify dd.py and students may inspect the solution for reference, this inconsistent ordering can cause confusion or errors if readers assume the same constructor signature across artifacts.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the DDNode field declaration order consistent between template and solution (preferably 'v: int' followed by 'successors: list[DD]') so the dataclass constructor signature is the same in both repositories. Update either the template or the solution dd.py accordingly and ensure any code that instantiates DDNode (if any) matches the chosen ordering.
